assessment_summary:
Each range below applies separately to every numbered line in that range.
0001–0103: Document metadata, definitions, formatting, and section setup; no mathematical inference requiring objection.
0104: Correctly invokes Siegel/Faltings for finiteness of integral points on hyperbolic curves.
0105: Blank line; no inference.
0106–0112: Definitions and notation for the Chabauty–Kim loci; justified as setup (the repeated S,1 in 0108 is a harmless indexing typo).
0113–0117: Historical/contextual statements supported by the cited results; no proof inference.
0118–0124: Statement of the theorem and its first three cases; no inference yet.
0125–0127: Source-boundary/display artifacts; no mathematical inference.
0128–0137: The connection and its dual are obtained by the cited Tannakian and connection formulas; the coefficient interpretation follows formally.
0138–0156: Lemma statement and proof setup; no inference beyond definitions.
0157–0161: Item (1) follows from the displayed Poincaré identity because multiplication by exp(t) does not change the coefficient span.
0162–0166: The induction for uniqueness is valid: the quotient lifts agree by induction, and the hypothesis M∩{h₁dh₂}=0 forces their remaining trivial-connection difference to be constant and hence zero at the chosen fiber.
0167–0173: A morphism of flat connections intertwines the connections, so applying it to exp(t) gives the required solution.
0174–0182: Subject to the stated universal property, local uniqueness identifies the rational coefficients with globally regular coefficients; justified.
0183–0192: The reduction to the last two unipotent degrees and the displayed differential formula follow from the vanishing of the indicated structure constants.
0193: FAILS: α_i is a differential one-form, whereas a_i+Σb_{ijk}a_kt_j is a function; the intended solved equation would be for a_i (and its sign must be checked), not for α_i.
0194: Merely closes the invalid display in 0193.
0195–0198: Not justified because they depend on 0193; moreover 0195 changes the range of i from the preceding lower layer to the top layer without explanation.
0199–0202: Not justified; the claimed vanishing does not follow from 0197, and the indices are transposed from λ_{ij} to λ_{ji}.
0203–0207: The factorization/contradiction would be plausible if the preceding vanishing were proved, but it is unsupported because 0193–0202 fail.
0208–0215: Section transition and statement of the cited codimension criterion; no new proof inference.
0216–0225: Moduli-space exact sequence and induced actions are invoked as cited background; justified conditionally on that cited result.
0226–0240: The commutator lemma is plausible from generation in degree one and reductive semisimplicity, though 0238 is overly terse; it does not repair the earlier failure.
0241–0248: The reduction follows from the cited virtual-basepoint and tangent-localization results.
0249–0269: The filtered codimension lemma and its reformulation are standard dimension bookkeeping; justified subject to the following filtered argument.
0270–0289: Sets up the filtered linear-algebra diagram; formatting only apart from the stated hypotheses.
0290–0300: The induction idea is sound, but 0297–0298 suppress the necessary index shift by i (A_k should be A_{i+k}); as written the displayed general formula is not correct for arbitrary i.
0301–0304: Ends the proof and introduces the next lemma; no new inference.
0305–0325: The Albanese image is made G_L-stable by realizing it as the image of a geometric endomorphism defined over a finite extension; 0306 should say G_L rather than Gal(L/Q), but the intended argument is clear.
0326–0337: Statement of the induction/restriction lemma; no proof inference.
0338–0374: The restriction/induction argument has the intended formal structure, but the second-row middle term in 0361 is global cohomology where a local term is required, so the displayed diagram is malformed as written.
0375–0394: The codimension comparison follows conditionally from the preceding induction/restriction lemma and the stated semisimplicity/direct-summand results.
0395–0403: Summary criterion and its numerical hypothesis are stated; no inference.
0404: Malformed inequality: it adds Ker(...) itself rather than dim Ker(...).
0405–0407: Closing display and conclusion of the criterion; the intended conclusion depends on correcting 0404.
0408–0411: Reduction to the displayed inequality follows from the cited criteria.
0412: Malformed for the same reason as 0404 (missing dim), and its local target uses U rather than gr_i(U).
0413–0416: The intended comparison follows only after correcting 0412.
0417–0448: Proposition statement and preliminary dimension reductions; these are conditional on cited earlier results, with several parenthesis/notation typos but no repair of 0193.
0449–0462: The central quotient and Artin–Tate dimension formula support the intended quadratic-Chabauty estimate; the final display has minor parenthesis errors but the conceptual deduction is recognizable.
0463–0491: Definitions and statement of the metabelian-module lemma; 0483 incorrectly uses n where the established symplectic basis has 2g entries.
0492–0502: Universal-property reduction to a free pro-p group is plausible.
0503–0505: As written, an infinite completed commutator module cannot be isomorphic to [U_i,U_i] for a fixed finite quotient i; an inverse limit or truncation is missing.
0506–0526: The cited graded-Lie/Ihara computation supports the intended module description, subject to correction of the preceding mismatch.
0527–0536: The injectivity lemma is asserted without proof; moreover its second alternative is too broad if the quotient relation is an arbitrary element, since such a quotient may acquire multiplication torsion.
0537–0551: Statement of the corollary; no inference.
0552–0564: The construction of v and injectivity of ad(v) are justified by avoiding finitely many proper subspaces and applying the cited injectivity lemma.
0565: The intended composite into W_{i+1}/W_{i+1}^{c=-1} is not actually written, but the subsequent contradiction explains it; this is a notation omission.
0566–0569: Ends the proof and introduces Poitou–Tate duality.
0570–0588: Statements of cited duality formulas; 0574 inconsistently writes G_Q although the representation and archimedean places are for K, so it requires G_K.
0589–0606: The local vanishing follows from purity when v≠p and the stated weights exclude eigenvalue 1; justified in the intended unramified/pure setting.
0607–0614: Soulé’s theorem is cited and used as background.
0615–0625: The Artin–Tate dimension formula is justified only when W has finite image, as indicated by the preceding prose; the lemma’s phrase “finite Q_p-representation” is otherwise ambiguous.
0626–0642: The cited injectivity and Iwasawa results give positive contributions infinitely often and vanishing kernels eventually.
0643: Malformed sum: H_f^1(...) is subtracted without taking its dimension.
0644–0645: The unboundedness conclusion is valid only after correcting 0643.
0646–0670: Statements of the two conjectures and the negative-K-group consequence; justified conditionally on those conjectures.
0671–0689: The Bloch–Kato deduction follows from the cited duality and direct-summand hypotheses, modulo the earlier notation errors.
0690–0695: Transition and setup for the Jannsen argument.
0696: Incorrect object as written: the argument concerns H^i(X^i,Q_p(i)), but the display uses H^i(X,Q_p(i)); for i>2 this latter cohomology of a curve vanishes.
0697–0703: The kernel calculation is intended to follow after replacing X by X^i in 0696.
0704–0712: Editorial note and statement/setup of Hain’s lemma.
0713–0735: The induction using commutators and the center of the truncated graded Lie algebra is plausible given Hain’s base case.
0736–0740: 0738 incorrectly writes H^{i-6}(X)^* raised to the (i−6)-th tensor power; the later 0746 shows that H^1(X)^* was intended.
0741–0746: The induction/decomposition conclusion is valid only with the correction to 0738.
0747–0755: Statement and setup of the complex-conjugation lemma.
0756: The claim and its proof test different eigenspaces: the claim says [v,w] is not c=1, while the contradiction assumes c[v,w]=−[v,w], which tests membership in c=−1.
0757: Blank line; no inference.
0758: The first displayed direct sum repeats X_α instead of using X_{α^c} in the second summand.
0759–0765: The equality in 0764 does not follow merely from containment in the anti-invariant subspace and surjectivity onto each factor; an additional dimension or lifting argument is missing.
0766: It chooses an arbitrary pair (v₁,v₂) without establishing that the pair lies in the image of W, which is needed to place its bracket in W_{i+1}.
0767–0771: The conjugation computation is algebraically consistent, but its use depends on the unsupported choices in 0764–0766.
0772–0775: The final Jannsen reduction is conditional on the flawed preceding lemma and therefore unproved.
0776–0786: CM-metabelian setup is plausible from the cited structure lemma.
0787: The graded piece indexed by i is identified using V_π^{⊗(n−3)}; its exponent cannot depend on n rather than i (and is inconsistent with the grading), so the formula is erroneous.
0788–0795: Subsequent local-vanishing reduction relies on correcting 0787.
0796–0803: Statement/proof setup; 0797 defines W_i as the image of W_i itself and is circular (it should refer to W^{⊗i}).
0804–0807: Shapiro’s isomorphism drops the Tate twist (1) on the right-hand side and is therefore not the stated isomorphism.
0808–0813: The Hochschild–Serre reduction is plausible after consistently specifying the coefficient representation and twist.
0814–0818: Incomplete: after “hence,” the Hom expression is displayed with no equality or assertion before “for all but finitely many i.”
0819–0822: Ends the incomplete proof and introduces the next cited estimate.
0823–0829: The theorem’s sum is indexed by j while the summand contains gr_i; as written i is free and the estimate is malformed.
0830–0836: Geometric setup and functoriality statement are standard.
0837: Malformed morphism: a closing parenthesis is missing around U_n(Res_{K/Q}(X)), so the displayed chain is not well-formed.
0838–0842: Defines the relevant image quotient, but the supplied proof excerpt terminates before proving case (4).
